title: Weekly Mindset Group Coaching Call | WLUPD
summary:
The meeting covered business development alongside discussions about identity, mindset, and personal growth. Participants shared progress on entrepreneurial projects and considered how beliefs and past experiences shape present actions.

Michelle had received 12–13 enthusiastic responses from potential podcast guests, with about 35 more people to contact. She planned to record four to six interviews in advance, then publish two interviews weekly; most episodes would run about 30 minutes and spotlight female entrepreneurs.

Farrah and Carlos were exploring a company name while a project was delayed. Farrah noted that the decision involved copyright, website, business-structure, and broader branding considerations; they had not settled on a name. She was also building her personal brand on Instagram. Carlos described developing research and technical skills through business challenges and applying them to support Farrah’s business. He said his focus was business and household financial stability, and that his relationship with his parents had improved.

Jackie had created a website, collaborated with others, and posted more consistently for her online business. She described her role as a light and servant who helps people understand options for improving health, wellness, and quality of life. The discussion contrasted acting from a chosen identity with relying on determination or waiting for more evidence.

Kim described moving from trying to convince herself she was enough toward appreciating herself and what she has. The group discussed how present-day interpretations of past events can affect current feelings and actions. Betsey said family-business dynamics kept the past close and that she felt more powerful during her divorce proceedings. David also emphasized acknowledging difficult feelings and balancing work with rest and enjoyment.
